transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. I'm here because I can’t seem to slow down—I’m constantly taking on new projects and working nonstop, like I’m stuck in overdrive. It just feels like my motor is running constantly and I can't find the brake.
Have you ever experienced periods where your mood felt significantly lower, or has this high-energy state been your baseline for a very long time?

No, this isn't my normal baseline at all; it only started about seven months ago when I began studying for my Master Electrician exam and took on a big solar contract. I haven't really had any periods of feeling low or depressed—it's just been this intense, non-stop high energy and irritability lately.

During these past seven months, have there been any specific periods where your need for sleep was drastically reduced, or where you felt so energized that it significantly interfered with your ability to function in your daily responsibilities?

Yes, for the past seven months I've only been sleeping about two or three hours a night because my mind is racing, but I still don't feel tired. It's definitely caused major problems, though—my boss actually pulled me off field work because of safety concerns, and my wife is furious about the debts I've run up.
During these past seven months, have you ever felt that you were hearing or seeing things others couldn't, or felt that you had special powers or were being monitored by others?

No, I'm not hearing or seeing things, and I don't feel like I'm being monitored. But as for special powers, while it's not supernatural, I do feel like I have a unique, superior vision for solar and smart homes that other electricians just aren't smart enough to grasp. I honestly believe I'm destined to completely revolutionize how people use this technology.

Have you ever felt so convinced of this unique vision that you took actions that were clearly dangerous or entirely out of character, such as believing you had abilities that defied the laws of physics or common logic?

I don't believe I have supernatural powers that defy physics, but I’ve been so sure of my vision that I pushed unsafe work timelines that scared my crew and bought expensive equipment on credit. I just feel like I can see brilliant solutions that other, less intelligent electricians can't grasp.
Have you ever felt that you were so uniquely talented or important that you were destined for fame or success far beyond what is realistic for your current situation?

Absolutely, I feel destined to completely revolutionize how solar and smart home technology is used in our area because I see designs other electricians aren't smart enough to understand. That's why I ignore my boss and wife when they tell me to slow down, because I know they'll thank me once they see how massive this business is going to be.
Have you ever felt, even for a brief moment, that you were communicating with a higher power, receiving secret messages from the media, or that your thoughts were being broadcasted to others?

No, I’ve never experienced anything like that. My mind is constantly racing with my own ideas, plans, and wiring designs, but I've never felt like I was receiving outside messages or that other people could hear my thoughts.

Have you ever experienced any moments where you felt your thoughts were so powerful that they could influence events or people around you, or that you were acting under the influence of a divine or external force, even if you weren't receiving messages?

No, I've never felt like I was under the influence of a divine or external force, and I don't think my thoughts can magically influence events. I just feel incredibly capable and highly intelligent when it comes to my electrical work, like I can see solutions others simply can't.

Has there ever been a time during this period where you felt so intensely focused on your work or ideas that you lost touch with reality, such as believing you had special status or abilities that others clearly did not recognize as being based in your professional expertise?

Yes, I absolutely feel that way. I am destined to revolutionize how solar and smart homes are used in this area because I see advanced solutions that other electricians simply aren't smart enough to grasp. I ignore my boss and my wife when they tell me to slow down because I know they'll thank me once they see how massive my plans are.

The duration of seven months without reported depressive episodes aligns with a current manic episode.
